timing: Written after the syntax/parser probe and before generating or fitting the known-truth PCM smoke data.

clarifications.main_facet_weight: Number of retained rating rows containing the facet level; this is independently recomputed from generated_ratings.csv.
clarifications.threshold_weight: Number of retained rating rows for the corresponding Criterion step-facet level; all transitions within a level receive the same weight.
clarifications.minimum_spearman: Minimum FACETS-versus-Python Spearman correlation across Rater, Task, and Criterion within each directly eligible run; constant or missing vectors fail closed.
clarifications.expanded_pcm_nullity: Rank nullity of the adjacent-category design after exact model constraints: Person noncentered, every non-Person main facet sum-to-zero, and every Criterion threshold vector sum-to-zero.
clarifications.paired_direction_check: Within each seed, the estimated RMS distance between the two Criterion threshold vectors must be larger in the deliberately heterogeneous condition than in the shared-threshold condition, for both FACETS and Python.
clarifications.known_truth_role: Truth errors and correlations are descriptive at smoke depth; only direction is gated. Bias, coverage, false-positive, and power claims remain prohibited.

locked_smoke_design.paired_randomness: Person measures and one uniform variate per rating row are identical across the two threshold conditions within a replicate.
